title: Siting and Curtailment Depth Limit the Grid Headroom Available to New Large Loads
abstract: arXiv:2611.00462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data center demand is increasing faster than generation can be built, encouraging proposals to interconnect large loads on condition that they reduce consumption during high-stress periods. Estimates of how much load can be added via flexibility rest on simplified accounting and report only annual curtailed electricity. Here we use a national energy systems model that co-optimizes hourly generation and load curtailment across 16 U.S. regions to characterize the flexibility and power system impacts of enabling headroom. While 50 GW can be served while curtailing less than 0.1% of its annual energy, small annual curtailment conceals potentially severe operating requirements. Most regions require curtailment deeper than 90% in at least one hour, so the load must disconnect or have sufficient on-site resources to provide full back up. translated_title: 选址与削减深度限制了电网可提供给新增大型负荷的余量
translated_abstract: 数据中心需求的增长速度超过了发电能力的建设速度，这促使人们提出在附带条件的情况下接入大型负荷，即要求其在电网高压力时段减少用电。目前关于通过灵活性可接入多少负荷的估算依赖于简化的核算方法，且仅报告年度削减电量。本文使用一个国家能源系统模型，对美国16个区域的逐时发电与负荷削减进行联合优化，以刻画启用电网余量的灵活性及其对电力系统的影响。结果显示，电网可以在年削减电量低于0.1%的情况下为50 GW的新增负荷供电，但较小的年度削减量掩盖了可能极为严苛的运行要求：大多数区域在至少一个小时内需要超过90%的削减深度，因此负荷必须能够完全断开连接，或拥有足够的现场资源以提供全面的备用供电。此外，已公布的数据中心选址与建模得到的电网余量并不匹配，而依赖现有的……
tldr: 论文通过对美国16个区域进行逐时发电与负荷削减联合优化的能源系统建模发现，尽管电网可在年削减电量不足0.1%的条件下为50 GW新增大型负荷供电，但多数区域在部分小时需要超过90%的削减深度、负荷须具备完全断开或现场备用能力，且已公布的数据中心选址与电网可用余量错位，这表明选址和削减深度才是限制电网余量的关键因素。
en_tdlr: Using a national energy systems model that co-optimizes hourly generation and load curtailment across 16 U.S. regions, this paper shows that while the grid can serve up to 50 GW of new large loads with under 0.1% annual energy curtailment, curtailment depths exceeding 90% in most regions—requiring full disconnection or on-site backup—and the misalignment between announced data center siting and modeled headroom are the true constraints on usable grid flexibility.
